title: Celebrity Tour December 2025
shortDescription: A landmark 10-day fan journey through Chennai and Madurai — featuring exclusive star meet-and-greets, temple city experiences, and the magical Pongal countdown atmosphere of Tamil Nadu.
longDescription:
December in Tamil Nadu is an extraordinary time to be a film fan. As the state gears up for the festive season, the film industry buzzes with premieres, press events, and charity galas — making it the perfect moment for our most ambitious celebrity tour to date.

Over ten carefully curated days, you will divide your time between Chennai, India's film capital for Tamil cinema, and the ancient temple city of Madurai. In Chennai you will access live film sets, attend a private screening of an upcoming release, and enjoy a personal interaction session with a confirmed Tamil star. In Madurai, the atmosphere shifts to one of deep spiritual culture as the city prepares its legendary December Music and Dance Festival.

This tour is limited to just 8 participants to ensure every experience remains intimate, personal, and unforgettable.
features: Exclusive star meet-and-greet with confirmed Tamil celebrity
Live film set access and private screening
December Music & Dance Festival in Madurai

itinerary.title: Arrival in Chennai
itinerary.details: Welcome at Chennai International Airport. Transfer to your 5-star hotel on ECR. Evening orientation walk along Marina Beach — the world's second longest urban beach — and a welcome dinner with your guide.

itinerary.title: Film Studio Immersion
itinerary.details: Full-day tour of a major Chennai film studio. Visit the costume atelier, prop department, and observe a live shoot in progress. Lunch with production staff and a behind-the-scenes briefing on how Tamil blockbusters are made.

itinerary.title: Celebrity Meet & Greet
itinerary.details: The signature moment of the tour. A private, structured interaction session with a confirmed Tamil film star — including a Q&A, personal photo opportunity, and exclusive signed memorabilia prepared by our team.

itinerary.title: Private Film Screening
itinerary.details: Attend a private pre-release screening of an upcoming Tamil film, arranged exclusively for our group. Post-screening discussion with a member of the crew.

itinerary.title: Chennai Cultural Day
itinerary.details: Morning visit to Kapaleeshwarar Temple in Mylapore, followed by a silk saree weaving demonstration at a traditional workshop. Afternoon free to explore T. Nagar shopping district.

itinerary.title: Journey to Madurai
itinerary.details: Morning scenic drive south to the ancient temple city of Madurai. Arrive by noon, check into a heritage hotel. Evening visit to the Meenakshi Amman Temple for the spectacular evening prayer ceremony.

itinerary.title: Meenakshi Temple Deep Dive
itinerary.details: Private guided architectural tour of the Meenakshi Temple complex with a specialist historian. Explore the Hall of a Thousand Pillars, the sacred tank, and the temple museum — with full Japanese interpretation provided.

itinerary.title: December Festival Experience
itinerary.details: Attend a curated selection of performances from the Madurai December Music and Dance Festival — featuring Bharatanatyam, Carnatic music, and traditional Nadhaswaram recitals. A rare cultural privilege.

itinerary.title: Madurai Heritage & Farewell Dinner
itinerary.details: Morning visit to the Thirumalai Nayakkar Palace. Afternoon at leisure. Evening grand farewell dinner at a rooftop venue overlooking the Meenakshi Temple gopurams lit up at night.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.details: Morning transfer to Madurai Airport or back to Chennai International for onward flights. Our guide accompanies you to the airport for a personal farewell.

Private star interaction with a confirmed Tamil film celebrity
Live film set access and private pre-release screening
Attendance at the legendary Madurai December Music Festival
Full Japanese-speaking escort for all 10 days
Small group of maximum 8 — a truly boutique experience

title: NTR Fan Meet & Telugu Cinema Experience
shortDescription: An exclusive 6-day celebrity tour centered around a confirmed NTR fan meet event, exploring the heart of Telugu cinema culture in Hyderabad and surrounding regions.
longDescription: Experience the magic of Telugu cinema with this exclusive tour built around a confirmed NTR (Jr. NTR) fan meet event. Hyderabad, the powerhouse of Telugu film industry, serves as our base as we explore film studios, visit iconic locations from blockbuster movies, and immerse ourselves in the vibrant culture of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. This shorter intensive tour packs maximum celebrity access and cultural experiences into 6 action-packed days, all guided by our expert Japanese-speaking team with insider connections to the Telugu film industry.
features: Confirmed NTR fan meet event with close interaction
Behind-the-scenes tour of major Telugu film studios
Visit iconic movie locations from recent blockbusters
Explore Hyderabad's film district and production houses
Golconda Fort sunset experience
Traditional Andhra cuisine cooking class and feast

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hyderabad
itinerary.details: Arrive at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, Hyderabad. VIP meet-and-greet and transfer to luxury hotel in the heart of the city. Evening welcome dinner featuring authentic Hyderabadi biryani and traditional Andhra delicacies. Tour orientation and NTR event briefing.

itinerary.title: NTR Fan Meet Event
itinerary.details: The main highlight! Attend the exclusive NTR fan meet event with premium access arranged through our industry connections. Experience close interaction with Jr. NTR, photo opportunities, Q&A session, and an unforgettable celebration of Telugu cinema. Evening group celebration dinner.

itinerary.title: Film Studio & Production Tour
itinerary.details: Full-day behind-the-scenes tour of a major Telugu film studio (Ramoji Film City or active production facility). Witness live shooting if schedules permit, explore elaborate sets, costume departments, and post-production facilities. Learn about the making of Telugu blockbusters from industry professionals. Lunch at the studio cafeteria.

itinerary.title: Iconic Movie Locations Tour
itinerary.details: Visit famous filming locations from recent Telugu blockbusters. Recreate iconic scenes, take photos at recognizable spots, and hear insider stories about the productions. Afternoon visit to film district where production houses and celebrity offices are located. Evening cultural performance showcasing traditional Kuchipudi dance.

itinerary.title: Heritage & Culture Day
itinerary.details: Morning visit to the magnificent Golconda Fort with its incredible acoustics and panoramic views. Afternoon explore the historic Charminar and surrounding bazaars for traditional shopping (pearls, bangles, textiles). Participate in an Andhra cooking class followed by a traditional feast. Sunset at Hussain Sagar Lake.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.details: Final breakfast at the hotel. Last-minute shopping at modern malls for Telugu cinema merchandise and souvenirs. Check-out and transfer to Hyderabad airport for your return flight to Japan. Depart with exclusive memories and insider stories from the world of Telugu cinema.

title: Jana Nayagan Fan Experience — Chennai
title_ja: ジャナ・ナヤガン ファン体験—チェンナイ
shortDescription: A 9-day confirmed tour to Chennai built around a private meeting with Vijay's parents, his birthday celebration, and an authentic experience of Tamil culture and city life.
shortDescription_ja: ヴィジャイの両親との個人面会、誕生日祝い、そしてタミル文化と都市生活の本物の体験を中心とした9日間の確定チェンナイツアー。
longDescription:
This tour offers access that no standard travel company can provide. Through Dr. Kanmani's personal relationships, guests will meet Vijay's parents, celebrate his birthday on June 22nd, and spend a night inside a Tamil family home. Every element of this tour has been confirmed and arranged well in advance.

Chennai is a city of ancient temples, vibrant food culture, and a film industry that moves millions of people across the world. Guests will visit celebrity homes, explore Dravidian temples, experience the East Coast Road beaches, and take part in a customised blouse-making session with a local tailor. Each activity has been selected to give a genuine view of the city rather than a surface-level tour.

This tour is designed for guests who want real access and real experiences, not a packaged itinerary. Dr. Kanmani personally oversees every detail, from the airport arrival to the farewell dinner. The group is limited to 10 guests so that every person receives full attention throughout the journey.
longDescription_ja:
このツアーは、通常の旅行会社では提供できないアクセスを提供します。カンマニ博士の個人的な関係を通じて、ゲストはヴィジャイの両親と面会し、6月22日の誕生日を祝い、タミル人家族の家で一夜を過ごします。このツアーのすべての要素は事前に確認・手配されています。

チェンナイは古代寺院、活気ある食文化、そして世界中の何百万人もの人々を動かす映画産業の都市です。ゲストはセレブの自宅を訪問し、ドラヴィダ寺院を探索し、イースト・コースト・ロードのビーチを体験し、地元テーラーによるカスタマイズブラウス製作に参加します。

このツアーは、パッケージ化された旅程ではなく、本物のアクセスと体験を求めるゲストのために設計されています。カンマニ博士が空港到着から送別ディナーまでのすべての詳細を個人的に監督します。グループは最大10名に限定されています。

faq.question: Is the meeting with Vijay's parents guaranteed?
faq.question_ja: ヴィジャイの両親との面会は保証されていますか？
faq.answer: Yes. This meeting is confirmed through Dr. Kanmani's personal relationship with the family. In the rare event of a cancellation due to unforeseen circumstances, a meaningful alternative will be arranged and compensation discussed individually with each guest.
faq.answer_ja: はい。この面会はカンマニ博士の家族との個人的なつながりを通じて確定しています。万一の場合は代替案と補償を個別に対応します。

faq.question: What is the homestay accommodation like?
faq.question_ja: ホームステマイの宿泊はどのようなものですか？

faq.question: Do I need to be a devoted Vijay fan to enjoy this tour?
faq.question_ja: このツアーを楽しむためにヴィジャイの熱狂的なファンである必要はありますか？

faq.answer_ja: まったくありません。誕生日セレブレーションと両親との面会が中心ですが、食、寺院、ビーチ、家族生活など、どの旅行者にも価値ある体験が揃っています。

faq.question: What should I wear for the temple visits and the parents' meeting?
faq.question_ja: 寺院訪問と両親との面会にはどのような服装をすべきですか？
faq.answer: Shoulders and knees should be covered for temple visits. For the parents' meeting, modest and respectful attire is recommended. Traditional Indian or Japanese dress is welcome but not required. A detailed clothing guide will be sent before departure.
faq.answer_ja: 寺院訪問では肩と膝を覆う服装が必要です。両親との面会では控えめな服装を推奨します。出発前に詳細な服装ガイドをお送りします。

title: Peddi Release Fan Tour — Hyderabad and Chennai
title_ja: ペッディ公開ファンツアー — ハイデラバードとチェンナイ
shortDescription: A 10-day tour following the release of Ram Charan's Peddi — from the LB Stadium launch event in Hyderabad to temples, celebrity homes, and beaches in Chennai.
shortDescription_ja: ラム・チャランのペッディ公開に合わせた10日間のツアー。ハイデラバードのLBスタジアムイベントからチェンナイの寺院、セレブ宅、ビーチまでを巡ります。
longDescription:
This tour is built around one of the most anticipated Telugu film releases in recent years. Guests will be present in Hyderabad for the official release event of Ram Charan's Peddi at LB Stadium, attend a private premiere screening the following day, and spend two full days watching the film in cinema halls across the city. There is no better way to experience a major South Indian film release than from inside it.

From Hyderabad, the group travels overnight by train to Chennai, arriving fresh for three days of carefully selected experiences. The tour covers the colonial coastline of Mahabalipuram, the residential streets where Tamil cinema's biggest stars live, three of Chennai's most significant temples, and the full stretch of Marina Beach. Dr. Kanmani's team handles every transfer, meal, and entry so that guests can focus entirely on the experience.

This tour is designed for guests who want to be present at a historic film release and then explore South India at a comfortable pace. Dr. Kanmani personally oversees every detail of the journey. The group is limited to 10 guests to ensure that the experience remains intimate and well-managed from the first day to the last.
longDescription_ja:
このツアーは、近年最も期待されているテルグ語映画の公開を中心に構成されています。ゲストはハイデラバードのLBスタジアムでラム・チャランのペッディの公式公開イベントに参加し、翌日はプライベートプレミア上映会に出席、さらに2日間にわたって市内の映画館でペッディを鑑賞します。南インドの大型映画公開をその内側から体験する最良の方法です。

ハイデラバードから夜行列車でチェンナイへ移動し、3日間の厳選された体験が始まります。マハーバリプラムの海岸線、タミル映画界の大スターが住む住宅街、チェンナイの重要な寺院3か所、そしてマリーナビーチを巡ります。カンマニ博士のチームがすべての移動、食事、入場を手配するので、ゲストは体験に集中できます。

このツアーは、歴史的な映画公開の場に立ち会い、その後ゆったりと南インドを旅したいゲストのために設計されています。カンマニ博士が旅のすべての詳細を個人的に監督します。グループは最大10名に限定され、最初から最後まで親密で丁寧な体験を提供します。

itinerary.title: Temple Visits
itinerary.details: Full day of temple visits covering Kapaleeshwarar Temple in Mylapore, Triplicane Perumal Koil, and Varadaraja Temple, with a Japanese-speaking guide throughout.
itinerary.details_ja: ミラポールのカパレーシュワラル寺院、トリプリケーン・ペルマル寺院、バラダラジャ寺院を巡る一日。日本語ガイド同行。

itinerary.title: Marina Beach
itinerary.details: Spend the day at Marina Beach, one of the longest urban beaches in the world. Evening farewell dinner at a Chennai restaurant.
itinerary.details_ja: 世界最長の都市ビーチの一つ、マリーナビーチで一日を過ごす。夜はチェンナイのレストランでお別れディナー。

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.details: Final breakfast at the hotel, then transfer to Chennai International Airport for the return flight to Japan.
itinerary.details_ja: ホテルで最後の朝食後、日本への帰りのフライトのためチェンナイ国際空港へ移動。

whatToExpect: A front-row experience of a major South Indian film release
Private premiere screening not open to the general public
Seamless travel between two major South Indian cities
Temples, beaches, and celebrity culture across Chennai
Small group travel with full support from Dr. Kanmani's team throughout
whatToExpect_ja: 南インドの大型映画公開を最前列で体験
一般公開されていないプライベートプレミア上映会
南インドの2大都市間のスムーズな移動
チェンナイの寺院、ビーチ、セレブ文化
カンマニ博士のチームによる全面サポートの少人数グループ旅行
inclusions: Accommodation throughout the tour
Japanese-speaking guide throughout
Airport pickup and drop-off
24-hour emergency support from Dr. Kanmani's team
inclusions_ja: 全行程を通じた日本語ガイド
カンマニ博士チームによる24時間緊急サポート
exclusions: International flights to and from India
Travel insurance (strongly recommended)
All meals (guests pay for their own)
Event tickets, cinema tickets, and entry fees
Personal shopping, souvenirs, and activity costs
Tips for guides and drivers (appreciated but optional)
exclusions_ja: インドへの往復国際線航空券
全食事代（ゲスト各自が負担）
イベントチケット、映画チケット、入場料
個人的なショッピング、お土産、アクティビティ費用
ガイドやドライバーへのチップ（任意）

faq.question: Is the special guest at the private premiere confirmed?
faq.question_ja: プライベートプレミアの特別ゲストは確定していますか？
faq.answer: The special guest for the June 3rd private premiere is currently being finalised. Details will be communicated to all guests ahead of the tour date. The private screening itself is confirmed regardless of the guest announcement.
faq.answer_ja: 6月3日のプライベートプレミアの特別ゲストは現在調整中です。詳細はツアー日程前にお知らせします。プライベート上映会自体は確定しています。

faq.question: How many cinema screenings will we attend in total?
faq.question_ja: 合計何回の映画鑑賞がありますか？
faq.answer: On June 4th and 5th, the group will watch up to three screenings of Peddi per day across cinema halls in Hyderabad. The exact schedule will be shared before departure based on available show times.
faq.answer_ja: 6月4日と5日に、グループはハイデラバードの映画館で1日最大3回のペッディを鑑賞します。詳細なスケジュールは出発前に公開上映時間に基づいてお知らせします。

faq.question: Is the overnight train journey comfortable?
faq.question_ja: 夜行列車の旅は快適ですか？
faq.answer: The group will travel in reserved air-conditioned sleeper class, which provides a private berth for each guest. Bedding is provided on board. Dr. Kanmani's team will accompany the group for the full journey.
faq.answer_ja: グループは指定席付きエアコン寝台クラスで移動し、各ゲストに個人用寝台が提供されます。寝具は列車内で提供されます。カンマニ博士のチームが全行程同行します。

faq.question: What is the best way to prepare for the temple visits?
faq.question_ja: 寺院訪問のための準備は何ですか？
faq.answer: Shoulders and knees should be covered at all three temples. Lightweight cotton clothing is recommended for June. Shoes must be removed before entering, so easy slip-on footwear is advised. A detailed preparation guide will be sent before departure.
faq.answer_ja: 3か所の寺院すべてで肩と膝を覆う必要があります。6月は軽い綿の服装を推奨します。入場前に靴を脱ぐ必要があるため、脱ぎ履きしやすい靴が便利です。出発前に詳細な準備ガイドをお送りします。
